import hashlib,json,urllib.request,zipfile,io
url=__import__('sys').argv[1]
req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'OnTrack-Native-OTA-Diagnostic'})
h=hashlib.sha256();data=bytearray()
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=18) as res:
    ct=res.headers.get('Content-Type','');enc=res.headers.get('Content-Encoding','')
    while True:
        b=res.read(262144)
        if not b:break
        data.extend(b);h.update(b)
        if len(data)>18000000:raise RuntimeError('DIAGNOSTIC_OVERSIZE')
print(json.dumps({'status':'downloaded','bytes':len(data),'type':ct[:80],'encoding':enc[:60],
'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'head_hex':bytes(data[:24]).hex(),
'tail_hex':bytes(data[-24:]).hex(),'zipfile':zipfile.is_zipfile(io.BytesIO(data))}))
